items.reason: Eligibility admits 'grade 4 GBM (IDH wild type), grade 4 diffuse astrocytoma (IDH mutant)', and prior grade 2 or 3 glioma that has progressed. IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under CNS5 (§1.1 note), so several glioma types are eligible and GBM is named: mixed_glioma_gbm_named.

note: Only intervention is CHM-1101 CAR-T cells (excluded type), so the trial fails S6 whatever the population code. any_molecular_selection is true because MMP2+ by IHC is an entry requirement; it is not candidate-matched because the CAR-T is not a candidate.
